s2_00: Top left of a menu picture: the left cover of an open leather-bound book on a dark red wooden table. The cover is brown-grey embossed leather with irregular wrinkled leather grain, a worn orange-red leather edge at the left and a black pencil-style sketch of a twin-engine propeller aircraft with speed lines in the upper middle. At the bottom left of the cover, cut through by the bottom edge of the tile, is a luggage-style name label: a cream-tan paper tag with a brown border, with a round gold coin-like badge on its left end. The gold badge has a dark brown silhouette of a propeller fighter plane seen from above in the middle with the letters 'PILOT' (P-I-L-O-T) across its wings; curved dark brown capital letters around the badge rim read 'ROGUE' with a small '& Co' at the top (R-O-G-U-E), 'FLIGHTS' at the lower left and 'LOG BOOKS' at the lower right. On the cream tag, in widely spaced typewriter capitals in dark brown at the top: 'PROPERTY OF:' (P-R-O-P-E-R-T-Y, O-F, colon). Below it, in large dark grey handwritten pencil-like letters: 'N. ZACHARY' (N, full stop, Z-A-C-H-A-R-Y). The right edge of the tile shows the dark spine gutter and the start of the right page of blank cream-grey paper. There is no other lettering anywhere.
